Over 12,000 scatterers give 12.4 scatter.zh: Over 12,000 scatterers give 12.4 scatterers per representative resolution cell. Measurement uses 224 by 768 samples; display is decimated to 56 by 96. The CNR tolerance is 35% because finite PSF leakage makes the cyst nonzero.
